map.由扩展不确定度求单侧 95% 保护带 使用指南: One-Sided 95% Guard Band from Expanded Uncertainty User Guide
map.输入校准或测量的扩展不确定度 U（含包含因子 k），按 GB = 1.65·U: Enter the expanded uncertainty U from calibration or measurement (including the coverage factor k), and compute the one-sided guard band at 95% confidence as GB = 1.65*U. Used to reserve safety margin inside the specification limit in conformity decisions, reducing the risk of misjudgement.
map.输入扩展不确定度 U，求 95% 单侧保护带值。: Enter the expanded uncertainty U to get the one-sided 95% guard band value.
map.：验收限 = 规格限 ± U（或按风险取 k*U）。例：上限 10.00、U=0: : Acceptance limit = specification limit +/- U (or k*U by risk). Example: upper limit 10.00, U = 0.02, accept at 9.98 to reduce false accepts.
map.：GB=1.65×0.12=0.1980。合格判定时把规范限向内缩 0.198，: : GB = 1.65 x 0.12 = 0.1980. In conformity decisions, pull the specification limit inward by 0.198 to push the false accept risk down to about 5%, at the cost of slightly more false rejects.
map.由公差带与测量标准差求测量能力指数: Find the measurement capability index from tolerance band and measurement standard deviation
map.由偏倚与标准差求偏移修正能力指数: Find the offset correction capability index from bias and standard deviation
map.由零件变差与测量误差求可区分类别数: Number of distinct categories from part variation and measurement error
map.留不确定度余量，减小把超差判为合格（误收）。: Leave uncertainty margin to reduce the chance of accepting out-of-tolerance parts (false accept).
map.过严增误废率，按风险平衡取舍。: Over-strict limits raise the false reject rate; balance by risk.
